title: MEDA sol 1187 weather replay
description: One sol of Perseverance MEDA pressure, air temperature and relative humidity at the Cheyava Falls site, plus one sol of MEDA wind from sol 312, in one-minute bins of local mean solar time, for the HUD environment strip (#20) and the mission clock (#59). Field definitions are in public/data/README.md.
historical_note: Every observation here is historical. None of it describes current conditions on Mars.

provenance.site: Jezero crater, Neretva Vallis at Cheyava Falls. Waypoints for sols 1185 and 1189 are 5 m and 12 m from the scene origin
provenance.reference: Rodriguez-Manfredi et al., Mars 2020 MEDA Bundle (urn:nasa:pds:mars2020_meda), NASA Planetary Data System, Atmospheres node
provenance.locator: Calibrated and derived environmental collections; formats in https://atmos.nmsu.edu/PDS/data/PDS4/Mars2020/mars2020_meda/document/meda_env_rdr_sis.pdf
provenance.license: MEDA data in PDS are public with no restriction of use (NASA SPD-41A).
provenance.note: Channels carry their own provenance block. Wind comes from a different sol and site, and its block says so.

time_axis.meaning: Each series t lists the LMST minutes (0 = local mean midnight, 1440 per sol) that have data. A value is the mean over [t, t+1). One LMST minute is 1/1440 sol, about 61.6 s. Minutes with no data are absent, so replay by interpolating between neighbours. The archive records MEDA in sessions, so the gaps are part of the record.

provenance.note: Mean of the three sensors on the remote sensing mast (ATS 1-3; ATS 4-5 sit on the rover body and are not used), then one-minute means. ATS has no derived level, so this is the calibrated level the readme recommends in that case. Dropped 0 samples outside 100-350 (fill value 999999999 or glitches). Bins with fewer than 30 samples are left out.

provenance.note: One-minute means. Relative to the sensor head temperature (HUMIDITY_LOCAL_TEMP), not to the air temperature. The SIS gives no unit for this column. The one-minute values on this sol run 0 to 9.7, which reads as percent. Dropped 1 samples outside 0-100 (fill value 999999999 or glitches). Bins with fewer than 30 samples are left out.

provenance.site: Jezero crater floor, 8.56 km from the scene origin and 221 m lower (waypoint sol 286), not at Cheyava Falls
provenance.reference: Rodriguez-Manfredi et al., Mars 2020 MEDA Bundle (urn:nasa:pds:mars2020_meda), NASA Planetary Data System, Atmospheres node
provenance.locator: Mars 2020 MEDA Wind Sensor Derived Data, column HORIZONTAL_WIND_SPEED (meter/second); units in https://atmos.nmsu.edu/PDS/data/PDS4/Mars2020/mars2020_meda/document/meda_env_rdr_sis.pdf
provenance.license: MEDA data in PDS are public with no restriction of use (NASA SPD-41A).
provenance.note: One-minute means of the horizontal speed. Dropped 1260 samples outside 0-60 (fill value 999999999 or glitches). MEDA wind is in the archive only up to sol 315 ('wind data beyond sol 315 is not provided due to certain damage to some components of the wind sensor', release notes section B.4, https://atmos.nmsu.edu/PDS/data/PDS4/Mars2020/mars2020_meda/document/meda_release_notes.txt). Sol 312 is the last sol before the January 2022 dust storm (sols 313-318) and has the most wind data of sols 300-312. It is MY 36 at Ls about 153, not the season of sol 1187. Only samples with ROVER_STILL = 1 are used. Bins with fewer than 30 samples are left out.
